title: Slot-claim seq store: cap NV growth and define eviction for dead gateway IIDs
description: Codereview finding (P2, security/robustness) on lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/slot_claim_settings.c: one settings entry per distinct committed gateway IID, never deleted (no settings_delete path). Gateway IID churn grows NV unbounded; NVS-full makes settings_save_one fail -> every claim rejected LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_PERSIST (liveness kill of GCP-6), and dead IIDs permanently consume load-order cache slots (8 max) which decides which floors survive reboot. Commits only happen after Schnorr48 verify so remote garbage is bounded by the TOFU key store, but the store still needs a cap/eviction/LRU policy decision plus a boot-time cleanup for entries over capacity. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-uiun 3x codereview.
